author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-Two! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Have you ever yearned to take revenge on the thoughtless powers that underpin the universe? Feel like Kratos-ing your way up to mount olympus and having it our with your god-dad? Ever just wanted to dress up in some Eyes-Wide-Shut gear and really give it to the neighbouring Sept? This game might be for you. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://www.wargamevault.com//product/565555/repent-ye-foolish-gods?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 072 - Repent! ye foolish gods by Snarling Badger Studios
